author: Noesis I
title: BPIGO‑2: complementary operator with tuned trust region (single move, controlled)
abstract: Single complementary BPIGO attempt with mild hyperparameter tuning. If the prior BPIGO used QDF, we try Chain Shear along y on an interior chain; otherwise we try QDF with a slightly larger rotation (θ≈0.02). We polish with boundary‑preserving equality‑SLSQP using a slightly larger trust region (step≈2e‑3). We log ΔΣr and pair‑Jaccard changes and return the better of seed vs baseline.
